41782.commentary: (MNa) sacce patiṭṭhāyā'ti thusarāsimhi ākoṭitakhāṇuko viya acalanto vacīsacce patiṭṭhahitvā.

examples.text: sace kho tvaṃ, gahapati, sacce patiṭṭhāya manteyyāsi siyā no ettha kathāsallāpo'ti. sacce ahaṃ, bhante, patiṭṭhāya mantessāmi, hotu no ettha kathāsallāpo'ti.

41783.meaning2: was established, stood firmly, found a support

examples.text: rañño imaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ passantassa pītiyā nirantaraṃ phuṭasarīrassa añjaliṃ paggahetvā ṭhitass'eva mahābodhi mūlasatena suvaṇṇakaṭāhe patiṭṭhāsi

41784.meaning2: was established, stood firmly, found a support

examples.text: sīle patiṭṭhito bhikkhu, indriyesu ca saṃvuto, bhojanamhi ca mattaññū, jāgariyaṃ anuyuñjati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kūṭ'āgāre vā kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ vā pācīnavātapānā sūriye uggacchante vātapānena rasmi pavisitvā kv'āssa patiṭṭhitā'ti? pacchimāyaṃ, bhante, bhittiyan'ti.
yadā pana te, soṇa, vīṇāya tantiyo na accāyatā honti n'ātisithilā same guṇe patiṭṭhitā, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
akkheyyasaññino sattā, akkheyyasmiṃ patiṭṭhitā, akkheyyaṃ apariññāya, yogam'āyanti maccuno.

41786.commentary: (MNa) patiṭṭhitan'ti yathā tena patiṭṭhitaṃ. sace evaṃ patiṭṭhissati, atha pana añña'd'eva vakkhati, tatra mayā kiṃ sakkā kātun'ti idān'eva piṭṭhiṃ parivattento āha.

examples.text: sace me samaṇo gotamo tathā patiṭṭhissati yathā ca me ñāt'aññatarena sāvakena assajinā nāma bhikkhunā patiṭṭhitaṃ… evam'ev'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi.

41788.meaning1: fact of being fixed; fact of being firmly grounded (in)

41790.meaning1: established in virtue; firmly grounded in ethical conduct
41790.meaning2: established in virtue; firmly grounded in ethical conduct

examples.text: dhuvasīlo'ti nibaddhasīlo. ṭhitasīlo'ti patiṭṭhitasīlo. sot'āpanno'ti sotasaṅkhātena maggena phalaṃ āpanno.

41792.meaning2: to be established, to stand firmly, to find a support

41793.meaning2: is stubborn; is obstinate; is pig-headed; is resistant

examples.text: kārako kārakatāya vādaṃ upeti, atha vā vuccamāno upavadiyamāno kuppati byāpajjati patiṭṭhiyati kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.

41794.meaning1: is stubborn; is obstinate; is pig-headed; is resistant

examples.text: dubbaṇṇasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patiṭṭhīyati kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.
vātavuṭṭhisamayo nāma bhikkhū sarajena vātena okiṇṇā honti, dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni kāye patitāni honti, vātavuṭṭhisamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, gahapati, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre tibbo vanasaṇḍo. tatr'assa rukkho sampannaphalo ca upapannaphalo ca, na c'assu kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni.
ahaṃ nāgo'va saṅgāme, cāpato patitaṃ saraṃ, ativākyaṃ titikkhissaṃ, dussīlo hi bahujjano.

41798.meaning1: location where something has fallen; landing place

examples.text: so ca phuṭṭhaviso hoti. tasmā patitaṭṭhānato paṭṭhāya therassa kāye dīpasikhā viya vaṭṭiṃ pariyādiyamānam'ev'assa visaṃ otiṇṇaṃ.
